title: Term, Renewal and Price Protection — Dental and Vision Savings Memberships
content:
# Term, Renewal and Price Protection

**Article.** Every Dental and Vision Savings Membership renews automatically for the same term. Before an annual renewal, the renewal notice is sent 30 calendar days before the renewal date. The membership fee is fixed for the current term. A fee change takes effect only at a renewal, and only after 30 calendar days of notice. A change of membership takes effect at the next renewal.

These settings are the same for all six memberships: Cascade Smile Savings Individual and Household, Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Individual and Household, and Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Individual and Household.

| Setting | All six memberships |
|---|---|
| Automatic renewal for the same term | Yes |
| Renewal notice before an annual renewal | 30 calendar days before the renewal date |
| Fee fixed for the current term (price lock) | Yes |
| Notice before a fee change takes effect at renewal | 30 calendar days |
| When a change of membership takes effect | At the next renewal |

## The same terms, by situation

| Situation | Outcome under the article |
|---|---|
| The term ends and the member has not cancelled | The membership renews for the same term |
| An annual renewal date approaches | The renewal notice goes out 30 calendar days before that date |
| The company changes the fee during a term | The current term's fee stays as it is; the new fee can apply from a renewal reached after 30 calendar days of notice |
| The member moves to another membership mid-term | The new membership takes effect at the next renewal |

## Hypothetical illustration

An annual membership with a hypothetical renewal date of September 30 has its renewal notice sent on August 31, which is 30 calendar days earlier.
